name: JavaScript and TypeScript (ESLint core and eslint-plugin-unicorn)
covers: ESLint's core rules for sound, consistent JavaScript and TypeScript, and eslint-plugin-unicorn rules for JavaScript.

rules.title: ESLint accessor-pairs: Enforce getter and setter pairs in objects and classes
ESLint arrow-body-style: Require braces around arrow function bodies
ESLint capitalized-comments: Enforce or disallow capitalization of the first letter of a comment
ESLint class-methods-use-this: Enforce that class methods utilize `this`
ESLint curly: Enforce consistent brace style for all control statements
ESLint default-case: Require default cases in switch statements
ESLint default-case-last: Enforce default clauses in switch statements to be last
ESLint default-param-last: Enforce default parameters to be last
ESLint dot-notation: Enforce dot notation whenever possible
ESLint eqeqeq: Require the use of === and !==
ESLint func-name-matching: Require function names to match the name of the variable or property to which they are assigned
ESLint func-style: Enforce the consistent use of either function declarations or expressions assigned to variables
ESLint grouped-accessor-pairs: Require grouped accessor pairs in object literals and classes
ESLint guard-for-in: Require for-in loops to include an if statement
ESLint id-length: Enforce minimum and maximum identifier lengths
ESLint max-classes-per-file: Enforce a maximum number of classes per file
ESLint max-depth: Enforce a maximum depth that blocks can be nested
ESLint max-nested-callbacks: Enforce a maximum depth that callbacks can be nested
ESLint max-params: Enforce a maximum number of parameters in function definitions
ESLint max-statements: Enforce a maximum number of statements allowed in function blocks
ESLint no-alert: Disallow the use of `alert`, `confirm`, and `prompt`
ESLint no-array-constructor: Disallow Array constructors
ESLint no-await-in-loop: Disallow `await` inside of loops
ESLint no-bitwise: Disallow bitwise operators
ESLint no-caller: Disallow the use of arguments.caller or arguments.callee
ESLint no-case-declarations: Disallow lexical declarations in case clauses
ESLint no-compare-neg-zero: Disallow comparing against -0
ESLint no-cond-assign: Disallow assignment operators in conditional expressions
ESLint no-console: Disallow the use of console
ESLint no-continue: Disallow continue statements
ESLint no-debugger: Disallow the use of debugger
ESLint no-delete-var: Disallow deleting variables
ESLint no-div-regex: Disallow equal signs explicitly at the beginning of regular expressions
ESLint no-dupe-class-members: Disallow duplicate class members
ESLint no-dupe-else-if: Disallow duplicate conditions in if-else-if chains
ESLint no-dupe-keys: Disallow duplicate keys in object literals
ESLint no-duplicate-case: Disallow duplicate case labels
ESLint no-duplicate-imports: Disallow duplicate module imports
ESLint no-empty: Disallow empty block statements
ESLint no-empty-function: Disallow empty functions
ESLint no-empty-pattern: Disallow empty destructuring patterns
ESLint no-empty-static-block: Disallow empty static blocks
ESLint no-eq-null: Disallow null comparisons without type-checking operators
ESLint no-eval: Disallow the use of `eval()`
ESLint no-extend-native: Disallow extending native types
ESLint no-extra-bind: Disallow unnecessary calls to `.bind()`
ESLint no-extra-label: Disallow unnecessary labels
ESLint no-implied-eval: Disallow the use of `eval()`-like methods
ESLint no-inline-comments: Disallow inline comments after code
ESLint no-irregular-whitespace: Disallow irregular whitespace
ESLint no-iterator: Disallow the use of the __iterator__ property
ESLint no-labels: Disallow labeled statements
ESLint no-lonely-if: Disallow `if` statements as the only statement in `else` blocks
ESLint no-loss-of-precision: Disallow literal numbers that lose precision
ESLint no-magic-numbers: Disallow magic numbers
ESLint no-multi-assign: Disallow use of chained assignment expressions
ESLint no-multi-str: Disallow multiline strings
ESLint no-negated-condition: Disallow negated conditions
ESLint no-nested-ternary: Disallow nested ternary expressions
ESLint no-new: Disallow new operators outside of assignments or comparisons
ESLint no-new-func: Disallow `new` operators with the `Function` object
ESLint no-new-wrappers: Disallow new operators with the String, Number, and Boolean objects
ESLint no-nonoctal-decimal-escape: Disallow \8 and \9 escape sequences in string literals
ESLint no-obj-calls: Disallow calling global object properties as functions
ESLint no-object-constructor: Disallow calls to the Object constructor without an argument
ESLint no-octal: Disallow octal literals
ESLint no-octal-escape: Disallow octal escape sequences in string literals
ESLint no-plusplus: Disallow the unary operators ++ and --
ESLint no-proto: Disallow the use of the __proto__ property
ESLint no-prototype-builtins: Disallow calling some `Object.prototype` methods directly on objects
ESLint no-redeclare: Disallow variable redeclaration
ESLint no-return-assign: Disallow assignment operators in return statements
ESLint no-script-url: Disallow javascript: URLs
ESLint no-self-assign: Disallow assignments where both sides are exactly the same
ESLint no-self-compare: Disallow comparisons where both sides are exactly the same
ESLint no-sequences: Disallow comma operators
ESLint no-setter-return: Disallow returning values from setters
ESLint no-sparse-arrays: Disallow sparse arrays
ESLint no-template-curly-in-string: Disallow template literal placeholder syntax in regular strings
ESLint no-ternary: Disallow ternary operators
ESLint no-unexpected-multiline: Disallow confusing multiline expressions
ESLint no-unneeded-ternary: Disallow ternary operators when simpler alternatives exist
ESLint no-unsafe-finally: Disallow control flow statements in finally blocks
ESLint no-unsafe-negation: Disallow negating the left operand of relational operators
ESLint no-unsafe-optional-chaining: Disallow use of optional chaining in contexts where the `undefined` value is not allowed
ESLint no-unused-expressions: Disallow unused expressions
ESLint no-unused-labels: Disallow unused labels
ESLint no-unused-private-class-members: Disallow unused private class members
ESLint no-useless-call: Disallow unnecessary calls to .call() and .apply()
ESLint no-useless-catch: Disallow unnecessary catch clauses
ESLint no-useless-computed-key: Disallow unnecessary computed property keys in objects and classes
ESLint no-useless-concat: Disallow unnecessary concatenation of literals or template literals
ESLint no-useless-constructor: Disallow unnecessary constructors
ESLint no-useless-rename: Disallow renaming import, export, and destructured assignments to the same name
ESLint no-var: Require `let` or `const` instead of `var`
ESLint no-void: Disallow void operators
ESLint no-warning-comments: Disallow specified warning terms in comments
ESLint no-with: Disallow with statements
ESLint one-var: Enforce variables to be declared either together or separately in functions
ESLint operator-assignment: Require or disallow assignment operator shorthand where possible
ESLint prefer-destructuring: Require destructuring from arrays and/or objects
ESLint prefer-exponentiation-operator: Disallow the use of `Math.pow` in favor of the `**` operator
ESLint prefer-numeric-literals: Disallow parseInt() and Number.parseInt() in favor of binary, octal, and hexadecimal literals
ESLint prefer-object-has-own: Disallow use of `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call()` and prefer use of `Object.hasOwn()`
ESLint prefer-spread: Require spread operators instead of .apply()
ESLint prefer-template: Require template literals instead of string concatenation
ESLint radix: Enforce the consistent use of the radix argument when using parseInt()
ESLint require-await: Disallow async functions which have no `await` expression
ESLint require-yield: Require generator functions to contain `yield`
ESLint sort-imports: Enforce sorted import declarations within modules
ESLint sort-keys: Require object keys to be sorted
ESLint sort-vars: Require variables within the same declaration block to be sorted
ESLint strict: Require or disallow strict mode directives
ESLint symbol-description: Require symbol descriptions
ESLint use-isnan: Require calls to isNaN() when checking for NaN
ESLint valid-typeof: Enforce comparing typeof expressions against valid strings
ESLint vars-on-top: Require `var` declarations be placed at the top of their containing scope
ESLint yoda: Require or disallow "Yoda" conditions
eslint-plugin-unicorn filename-case: Enforce a case style for filenames and directory names.
eslint-plugin-unicorn no-null: Disallow the use of the `null` literal.
eslint-plugin-unicorn prefer-node-protocol: Prefer using the `node:` protocol when importing Node.js builtin modules.
